task: Align GitOps chart APISIX ingress controller memory requests/limits with 08-1 install values (Narwhal#424)

events.summary: gitops/** is a high-risk path (risk-policy.json). Scope: align ingressController.resources in gitops/charts/narwhal-apps/templates/apisix.yaml to 256Mi request / 512Mi limit matching scripts/cluster/08-1-networking.sh (#403, D-ic-mem). Live cluster is not modified; live kakao-narwhal controller is a separate Helm release at 512Mi.

In 08-1-networking.sh, APISIX ingress controller was OOMKilled at startup under 256Mi limit during full resource sync (#403), requiring 256Mi request and 512Mi limit. gitops/charts/narwhal-apps/templates/apisix.yaml was not updated in #403 and remained at 128Mi/256Mi, creating latent drift and OOMKill risk for chart installs.

Updated ingressController.resources in gitops/charts/narwhal-apps/templates/apisix.yaml to requests.memory 256Mi and limits.memory 512Mi with D-ic-mem comment. Extended regression check R258 in scripts/test/regression-check-kakao.sh to assert memory limits in both 08-1-networking.sh and apisix.yaml.

events.scope: extended R258 regression check and mutation verification
events.summary: R258 regression check passes verifying both 08-1-networking.sh and apisix.yaml memory allocations. Negative mutation test reverting apisix.yaml to 128Mi/256Mi fails R258 as expected.

events.scope: full static regression suite and markdown linting
events.summary: make test passed with 0 failures; markdownlint on CHANGELOG.md passed with 0 errors.

The GitOps chart apisix.yaml ingressController resources memory is updated to 256Mi request / 512Mi limit, and regression check R258 enforces the floor across both install script and chart. The live cluster was NOT changed (live kakao-narwhal controller is a separate Helm release at 512Mi and is not managed by Argo CD).
Static alignment of GitOps chart memory resources with 08-1 verified via extended R258 regression check, mutation proof, and full static regression test suite. Live cluster was not modified.
